name: ambient
character: ambient / calm / drone: slow beds that hold their level, little or no melody and no kick

pattern.loop_short.reason: beds and drones loop for long stretches by design

pattern.flat_dynamics.reason: a bed holds its level; the change is in colour, not loudness

pattern.velocity_flat.reason: pads and drones are not accented

pattern.melody_notes.reason: slow repeated tones are the style, with no beat grid to avoid

pattern.flags_max.reason: few parts, so fewer varied lines

kick.grid.reason: no kick is expected in an ambient piece
